text:
Noa D.: Quick kickoff for Symphony Systems joint benchmark. Goal: tight, repeatable perf/W numbers + steady-state throughput (aiming 1.8k-2.2k toks/s). Want minimal friction for partner: deliver kernel tweaks as drop-in user modules, no rebuild. Proposed lab slot Tue 10:00 PT. Who takes telemetry + embargo guardrail?
Carlos V.: I can own telemetry ingestion. Prefer JSONL 1s cadence with pdu_watts + token latency + model tags. Need to lock models/datasets.
Noa D.: Lock to redwood-mini-suite-v3 + open-symphony-7b-q4. Inputs: redwood-microbench-v4 (deterministic). KV cache OFF. Batch sizes: 1,4,16,64. Sequence 2048.
Imani K.: I'll package modules as /opt/symphony/plugins and provide apply/rollback scripts + SBOM. We'll also provide a short verification script so partner can smoke apply before runs.
Carlos V.: Telemetry schema draft fields: ts, run_id, model, batch, seq_len, tokens, latency_ms, gpu_watts, pdu_watts, kernel_flag. Will open PR to #eng-ml with schema + example by Mon EOD. Also will publish small ingest CLI for partner to test.
BenchBot: Lab reservation: symphony-lab-7 reserved Tue 10:00-14:00 PT for `symphony_joint_bench`. Use `@BenchBot extend symphony-lab-7 1h` to add time.
Noa D.: Comms: partner asked for co-listed datasheet and marketplace entry. Recommend 48-72h internal validation window post-run. @LegalBot can you confirm NDA/embargo constraints?
LegalBot: Noted. Default: 48h internal validation; if partner NDA specifies longer, will flag. Please attach proposed announcement language for pre-clearance.
Imani K.: Security: will run signed static scan on module tarball and include a short ADVISORY.md noting any kernel symbols touched. We'll avoid exported symbols where possible.
Noa D.: Run automation: standardize the command so results are comparable across partners. Share with partner as-is.

```
./symphony_bench --suite redwood-mini-suite-v3 \
  --models open-symphony-7b-q4,redwood-mpt-7b-q4 \
  --seq 2048 --batches 1,4,16,64 \
  --metrics throughput,latency,perf_per_watt \
  --record-kernel traces/symphony_tue \
  --out artifacts/symphony_tue/results.jsonl
```
Carlos V.: Add perf/W abort rule: if perf/W regresses >6% vs baseline/symphony-ref then abort and capture full kernel traces and syslogs to /artifacts/symphony_tue/aborts. Also capture a short telemetry snapshot for post-mortem.
Imani K.: Will upload module tarball + apply/rollback + SBOM to /artifacts/symphony_tue/modules.tar.gz by Tue 08:00 PT.
Noa D.: Action items recap: Carlos -> telemetry PR + ingest CLI (Mon EOD); Imani -> module tarball + verification script + SBOM (Tue 08:00); Legal -> confirm embargo & pre-clear language (ASAP). Dry-run Mon 16:00 PT so partner can smoke-test ingestion.
Carlos V.: I'll also add a small sanity check script that verifies pdu_watts reporting and token-rate consistency before we start full sweeps.
Imani K.: I'll include seccomp profile and a short runbook snippet documenting how to revert modules.
Noa D.: Thanks team. Aim to close outstanding PRs by Mon EOD and run dry-run Mon 16:00. :thumbsup:
